verse.text: So again I say, each man must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.

reflection: Loving your wife the way Christ loved the church isn't about grand gestures every day—it's choosing patience when you're tired, kindness when you'd rather be right, and presence when the couch and the phone are easier. Your kids are watching how you treat their mother far more closely than they're listening to what you say about love. Get this one relationship right, and you're modeling the whole gospel for your family without ever needing a sermon.
